hypothesis: `skinparam <<Public>> { ArrowColor #0a0 }`: upstream's opener `[\w.]*(?:<<.*>>)?[\w.]*` accepts an EMPTY name, pushes `<<Public>>`, keys `<<public>>arrowcolor`, and cleanForKeySlow moves the stereo to the end (`arrowcolor<<public>>`). Our RE_SKINPARAM_SELECTOR_BLOCK_OPEN (src/core/preprocessor-collector.ts:73) needs `\w+` before `<<`, so the whole block is never collected. Probe: the flat spellings ArrowColor/ComponentBorderColor/InterfaceBackgroundColor<<Public>> already render like the jar (c7); the block spelling does not (c8).

`OS ...> BUS #aaa` / `PSS <---- EEI_PS #000000: ...`: upstream reads the trailing COLOR group with `link.setColors(color().getColor(arg, ...))` (:329). LINK_LINE_RE captures `(?<color>...)` (link-grammar-regex.ts:174), but parseLinkLine (link-grammar.ts:428) only takes `color` from the bracket arrow-style, so the trailing colour is thrown away. Probe c1: the jar draws #AAA/#000 and we draw #181818.

At skinparam dpi 60 (factor 0.625) the jar formats width*scale once (`format(xx)` = `xx * option.getScale()`, then `%.3f`). Our description body is formatted at scale 1 and then re-scaled as a string (core/TextBlockExporter.ts#formatScaledFragmentBody via assemble-svg), so the value is rounded twice. Example: `Color` = 33.5125008 at 1x becomes `33.513`, and x0.625 gives 20.945625, printed 20.946. The jar computes 20.9453 and prints 20.945. Activity already avoids this with RenderFragment.numbersDeferred (renderer.ts / assemble-svg-activity.ts); the description engine does not opt in.

addMagic(component/interface_) registers `<sname>BorderColor` and addConFont (`<sname>FontColor`); addConFont("arrow") registers ArrowFontColor. The ctor strips `<<label>>` off any key. Our flat-key stereo matchers cover only BackgroundColor, BorderColor and ArrowColor: probe c9 shows ComponentFontColor<<X>>, InterfaceBorderColor<<X>>, InterfaceFontColor<<X>> and ArrowFontColor<<X>> all ignored (text #000 and ellipse stroke #181818, where the jar draws #0A0). These diffs stay after the block-opener fix.

`skinparam component { Shadowing<<package>> true }` converts to Shadowing 3 on component+stereo `package` (convertNow: true->3, addMagic Shadowing). Cluster#getStyle signs it withTOBECHANGED(group.getStereotype()), and drawU reads style.getShadowing(). Our renderer-cluster.ts:218 calls resolveElementShadowing(theme, symbol) (core/theme-element-resolve.ts:167), which has no stereotype argument and no ByStereo field, so the filter def and every rect@filter are missing. Probe c3 fails even without hide stereotype.

`EEI_BULK -[hidden]-- EEI_PS` (in.puml:136) makes our extra `<g class="link" id="lnk63">`. goHidden sets Link.hidden, and SvekResult draws that edge through ug.apply(UHidden.HIDDEN). The SVG paints nothing, but the edge still goes through the drawing pass (ink extent). Our DescriptionEdgeGeo.hidden deliberately leaves out the bracket disjunct (layout-helpers-types.ts:223-243, layout-geo-post.ts:114-117): an earlier attempt skipped the draw entirely and shrank the dujodu/tujica canvases. The fix has to suppress paint while keeping the extent. The extra root child shifts compareSvg's LCS pairing by one for every jar group 1..130 (all children key `g`; backtrack leaves our first child unmatched).

Upstream styles an entity or group from the FULL `entity.getStereotype()` (withTOBECHANGED) and uses getVisibleStereotypeLabels only for the printed labels. Our layout-dot-tree.ts:275,535-536,578-579 stores only the visible (filtered) labels in geo.stereotype, and the renderers resolve stereotype styles from that field. Under `hide stereotype` every <<V3>>/<<external>> background (and the <<Public>>/<<Protected>> entity styles) falls back to the plain bucket. Probe c5 (hide stereotype) gives all #FFF; c3 (without it) matches the jar except the tie case.

Cluster ent0174 (`"SiteOps Service\n(formerly Deployment Service)"`, which has port SIH) is drawn 38px (unscaled) wider than the jar, with the same centre. manageEntryExitPoint calls ensureMinWidth(getTitleAndAttributeWidth()+10), where the width comes from the merged multi-line stereo+title TextBlock. Our buildPortClusterInfoByAstId (layout-cluster-boxes.ts:41) still measures the raw display through measureTitleLabel (title-label-sizing.ts:54) as one line with a literal \n (about 289+10 = 299, vs the jar's dot rect of 261), instead of reusing clusterTitleDimsById (the D5 dims that the DOT already uses, dotEqual=true).

`V3ConsumerWebsite <<V3>> <<external>>` with both BackgroundColor<<V3>> and <<external>> at equal (+1000) priority: StyleStorage iterates a LinkedHashMap in definition order, Style.mergeWith calls new.mergeWith(previous), and DarkString keeps `other` (the previous value) unless the new priority is strictly bigger. So the FIRST-defined style wins the tie (#8FF). Our core stereotypePaint (theme-element-resolve.ts:51) lets the LAST matching label win (#FF0, probe c3). Probe c3 cannot separate definition order from label order (V3 is first in both); T6b needs one reversed jar probe.

Every diff under jar svg/g[1]/g[1..130] compares jar group n with our group n+1, because of the extra lnk63. Re-running compareSvg with lnk63 removed (realign.mts) gives 212/43: these 1814 diffs collapse into the latent counts of the other families. Jar groups 131..220 already pair correctly and are classified directly.

The canvas is 3.75 smaller in both W and H (6px unscaled = 2*deltaShadow 3). The extreme rects are the shadowed clusters ent0083 (max x) and ent0077 (max y); LimitFinder adds getDeltaShadow()*2. The title and legend are centred on the canvas width, so they shift by 1.875.
